name: tidy
description: Applies quality-only cleanups to the code you just changed: missed reuse, dead code, wrong altitude, needless abstraction, defensive noise, and compatibility scaffolding. Scope-fenced to the current diff, never changes behavior, never commits, and runs the project's tests to prove it. Pins an explicit model on every sub-agent instead of inheriting the session tier. Designed to run BEFORE /chad-review, so the gate reviews the tidied diff and is not re-armed by later edits.
